data.raw_text:
TRAFFIC UPDATE: As of 1:50 AM, expect moderate to light traffic at EDSA Guadalupe in front of San Carlos Seminary Southbound due to the ongoing digging/excavation activities of the Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH). Three lanes remain passable.

MMDA traffic enforcers are on site managing traffic. 

Motorists are advised to take alternate routes. #mmda
